text: The source that classifies the 2025 loss area as native forest is the Uruguay Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries (MGAP) National forest cartography dataset, version 2021. This dataset is referenced in the observation tool output, which specifies the forest type over the event area, indicating 13.1 hectares as native forest. The MGAP dataset is one of the authorized datasets used in the analysis, as shown in the run_metadata tool output.
